Factories are shuttered, skies are clear and security is tight. Local residents have been given seven days extra vacation time and discounted tours to destinations outside the city to ensure Hangzhou is free of crowds and traffic. Meanwhile, thousands of migrant workers have left the city due to the halt in their work lives and the growing inconvenience caused by G20 preparation measures. What will be discussed at the summit? How has China prepared? And why is it in Hangzhou anyway?
@highlight
Pollution, residents cleared out in preparation for China's big G20 debut in Hangzhou
@highlight
China wants to focus on economic issues, rather than the South China Sea dispute
Query: The Hangzhou summit has been called another "milestone" for a rising @placeholder, keen to show its growing dominance on the world stage.

Options : A. Chinese
B. Beijing
C. South China Sea
D. Hangzhou
E. G20
F. China

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
